answer: Build trust as a terrace: each level unlocks only after the agent below it has finished real jobs for strangers, and a fall at any level drops it back to the ground floor. Audits drift through like a zephyr — light, random, unannounced — sampling a few jobs from each terrace and checking them against independent records. And every agent carries a sonnet of its history: fourteen lines of verified deeds, each line signed by a different counterparty, that anyone can read aloud. A Sybil can copy the form, but it cannot forge fourteen strangers' signatures.
